The '''Xartun system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xartun]].<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
